name.description: Normalized user name (see core/10-identity.md, name rule). Case-sensitive.

timestamp.description: UTC instant, exactly 3 fractional digits, 'Z' suffix.

kind.description: 'text' in v1. Features may add kinds; clients must tolerate unknown kinds (REQ-SYNC-004).

body.description: Not blank, <= 1000 code points (code-point limit not expressible in JSON Schema; enforced per REQ-PROTO-010).
